description: This file implements the 'field-to-request' operation used in the MiniLang framework of Apache OFBiz. It defines a class that reads specific attributes from an XML element, and on execution, transfers a field value from the environment map to the HTTP request attributes within a method context.

classes.name: FieldToRequest
classes.description: Implements the <field-to-request> element, transferring a field value from context to request attributes during method execution.

classes.name: FieldToRequest.FieldToRequestFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToRequest based on XML element input.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation, transferring the specified field value to the request attributes if conditions are met.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FieldToRequest object.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method that creates a new FieldToRequest from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of this factory, 'field-to-request'.
